title: KCF Codegen Realization Manifest v1
description: Machine-readable accounting that a code generation handled every semantic identity in the IR. Replaces the prose 'dropped: []' self-attestation with a manifest a verifier can check against the model and (with --repo) the generated repository - so lossless handoff (decision D-005) is checked, not merely asserted. The verifier reports an evidence level; without a repository the manifest is 'accounted' (declared), not proof the artifacts exist.

semanticId.description: An IR semantic identity (concept qualifiedName, action id, rule id, relationship id, ...).

disposition.description: realized/enriched require artifact evidence; delegated/out-of-tier/deferred/unsupported require an explicit note.

artifacts.description: Generated files/symbols realizing this identity (required for realized/enriched).

note.description: Explicit reason (required when the identity is delegated/out-of-tier/deferred/unsupported).
